svg.title: Which hosts each process contacts
svg.desc: For each process, three lanes: the services in the cluster that it reaches, the fixed hosts on the internet that it reaches, which are the seed of phase 4's allowlist, and the hosts that a manifest author chooses. The app reaches MariaDB, Redis, Loki, the Kubernetes api, the LLMHosts and the self-hosted vectorstores; the LLM providers' apis, Pinecone, the social sign-in providers, GitHub, the account manager's api, SES's SMTP endpoint and AWS's STS, EKS and Auto Scaling; and, chosen by a manifest author, the MCPClients' servers, whose catalogs it lists, the vectorstores' ApiConnections, and the LLMClients' and LLMHosts' custom endpoints. The default worker reaches the LLM providers, Pinecone, GitHub and the blog, the extension registry, SES and S3; and, chosen by a manifest author, the MCPClients' servers, the vectorstores' ApiConnections, the providers' pages and the LLM prices' source pages. The infrastructure worker reaches Route53, ACM, EKS, STS and public DNS; beat only Redis and STS; the init Job GitHub, the extension registry, the LLM providers, SES, Slack and AWS. The tool worker reaches only Redis and MariaDB's port in the cluster, and every host that a tool call chooses on the internet: that is its purpose. Every host that a manifest author chooses outside the tool worker must be moved behind it or added to the allowlist before phase 4 enforces.
svg.text: the fixed hosts are the seed of phase 4's allowlist; the hosts a manifest author chooses decide its open questions
